PRECAUTIONS
Conc. HN03 should not be used otherwise N02 gas is evolved.
HN03 should not be very dilute otherwise N20 gas is evolved.
Apparatus should be airtight. All the glasswares should be handled with care.
The lower end of the thistle funnel should dip into the solution.
